sections.shortTitle: Privatization Commission Authentication Of Documents Under Common Seal Regulations 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

Privatization Commission Authentication Of Documents Under Common Seal
Regulations 2001
Privatization
Commission Authentication Of Documents Under Common Seal Regulations 2001
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 4th August,
2001]
S.R.O. 564(1)/2001, dated 1‑8‑2001.‑‑In
exercise of powers conferred by section 41 of the Privatization Commission
Ordinance, 2000 (LII of 2000), read with section 43 thereof, the Privatization
Commission hereby makes the following Regulations, namely:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) These regulations may be called the
Privatization Commission (Authentication of Documents Under Common Seal)
Regulations, 2001.
(2) They shall come into force at
once.

Definition

Privatization Commission Authentication Of Documents Under Common Seal
Regulations 2001
Privatization
Commission Authentication Of Documents Under Common Seal Regulations 2001
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 4th August,
2001]
S.R.O. 564(1)/2001, dated 1‑8‑2001.‑‑In
exercise of powers conferred by section 41 of the Privatization Commission
Ordinance, 2000 (LII of 2000), read with section 43 thereof, the Privatization
Commission hereby makes the following Regulations, namely:‑‑
2. Definition.‑‑(1)
In these rules, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context:‑‑
(a) "common seal" means
the seal made and kept pursuant to section 43 of the Ordinance;
(b) "documents" means
the documents specified in Regulation 5 of these regulations;
(c) "Ordinance" means
the Privatization Commission Ordinance, 2000 (LII of 2000);
(d) "register" means
the register kept in accordance with Regulation 6 of these regulations.
(2) All other terms and
expressions used, but not defined in these rules, shall have the same meanings
as assigned to them in the Ordinance.

sections.shortTitle: Privatization Commission Authentication Of Documents Under Common Seal Regulations 2001
sections.description:
Documents to be authenticated

Privatization Commission Authentication Of Documents Under Common Seal
Regulations 2001
Privatization
Commission Authentication Of Documents Under Common Seal Regulations 2001
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 4th August,
2001]
S.R.O. 564(1)/2001, dated 1‑8‑2001.‑‑In
exercise of powers conferred by section 41 of the Privatization Commission
Ordinance, 2000 (LII of 2000), read with section 43 thereof, the Privatization
Commission hereby makes the following Regulations, namely:‑‑
4. Documents to be
authenticated.‑‑Following documents shall be executed under the
common seal:‑‑
(1) confirmed minutes of the
meetings of Board of the Privatization Commission as signed by the Chairman,
Privatization Commission;
(2) all agreements/ deeds for
transfer of property;
(3) any other document as may be
specifically approved by the Secretary to be executed under common seal.

sections.shortTitle: Privatization Commission Authentication Of Documents Under Common Seal Regulations 2001
sections.description:
Manner for authentication of documents

Privatization Commission Authentication Of Documents Under Common Seal
Regulations 2001
Privatization
Commission Authentication Of Documents Under Common Seal Regulations 2001
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 4th August,
2001]
S.R.O. 564(1)/2001, dated 1‑8‑2001.‑‑In
exercise of powers conferred by section 41 of the Privatization Commission
Ordinance, 2000 (LII of 2000), read with section 43 thereof, the Privatization
Commission hereby makes the following Regulations, namely:‑‑
5. Manner for authentication
of documents.‑‑The manner for authentication of documents
shall, if, and to the extent, the Commission deems necessary, include‑‑
(1) a register indicating the
type of documents, name and signature of officer proposing the authentication,
name and signatures of the officer by whom the documents are authenticated
shall be maintained;
(2) the documents to be
authenticated shall be entered in chronological order in the register;
(3) the register shall be
inspected by the Secretary once a month.
